notes: No xtext evidence, because the pinned SysML.xtext defines no SourceEnd; it reaches the same shape through MultiplicitySourceEnd, which belongs to TargetSuccession's chain rather than this one. No corpus evidence either: every instance found in the corpus takes the empty form, so no line of text distinguishes this production from its own absence.
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.9.3: `SourceEnd : ReferenceUsage = ( ownedRelationship += OwnedMultiplicity )?`. There is no second opinion to weigh — the pinned pilot grammar has no SourceEnd rule, as it has none for SourceEndMember or SourceSuccession above it — so the clause is the only source. The whole production is optional, so it derives the empty string, which is the usual case: a source succession names no source, because the source is the body item it follows. The multiplicity is the one thing that can be written for it.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
